A circle and a square have the same circumference/perimeter (44 cm). Which has greater area? (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Circle: C=44 → r=7 cm. A = (22/7)×49 = 154 cm². Square: P=44 → s=11 cm. A = 121 cm². Circle (154) > Square (121). For same perimeter, circle has maximum area.

questions.question: A circular clock face has area 154 cm². Length of the minute hand (= radius, π = 22/7) =
If the radius is halved, by what factor does the area change?
questions.explanation: A = πr². New r = r/2. New area = π(r/2)² = πr²/4 = original area ÷ 4. Area is quartered when radius is halved (area scales as r²).
